package probe

import (
    "database/sql"
    "fmt"
    "path/filepath"
    "testing"

    _ "github.com/duckdb/duckdb-go/v2"
)

// Exercise the real Go bindings, native library and built-in extensions.
// No extension downloads or external database are permitted by this fixture.
func TestPortableDuckDB(t *testing.T) {
    db, err := sql.Open("duckdb", "")
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    t.Cleanup(func() { if err := db.Close(); err != nil { t.Error(err) } })
    db.SetMaxOpenConns(1)
    for _, q := range []string{
        "SET threads=2", "SET memory_limit='256MiB'",
        "SET autoinstall_known_extensions=false", "SET autoload_known_extensions=false",
        "LOAD json", "LOAD parquet", "LOAD icu", "SET TimeZone='UTC'",
    } {
        if _, err := db.ExecContext(t.Context(), q); err != nil { t.Fatalf("%s: %v", q, err) }
    }
    var version string
    if err := db.QueryRowContext(t.Context(), "SELECT version()").Scan(&version); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if version != "v2.0.0" { t.Fatalf("version=%q", version) }
    for _, tc := range []struct{name, query string; want int64}{
        {"query", "SELECT 42::BIGINT", 42},
        {"aggregate", "SELECT sum(i)::BIGINT FROM range(100) r(i)", 4950},
        {"json", `SELECT json_extract('{"answer":42}', '$.answer')::BIGINT`, 42},
        {"icu", "SELECT hour(timezone('Asia/Shanghai', TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'))::BIGINT", 8},
    } {
        t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
            var got int64
            if err := db.QueryRowContext(t.Context(), tc.query).Scan(&got); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
            if got != tc.want { t.Fatalf("got=%d want=%d", got, tc.want) }
        })
    }
    file := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "rows.parquet")
    if _, err := db.ExecContext(t.Context(), fmt.Sprintf("COPY (SELECT 42::BIGINT AS answer) TO '%s' (FORMAT PARQUET)", file)); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    var got int64
    if err := db.QueryRowContext(t.Context(), "SELECT answer FROM read_parquet(?)", file).Scan(&got); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if got != 42 { t.Fatalf("parquet round trip=%d", got) }
}
